mapper.select: SELECT A.FILE_SEQ AS fileSeq, A.ATCH_FILE_ID AS atchFileId, A.TIME_INTERVAL AS timeInterval, A.FILE_ORDER AS fileOrder, B.PLAY_TIME AS playTime, B.FILE_WIDTH AS fileWidth, B.FILE_HEIGHT AS fileHeight, B.ORIGNL_FILE_NM AS orignlFileNm, B.STRE_FILE_NM AS streFileNm, CASE WHEN LOWER(B.FILE_EXTSN) IN ('mp4', 'avi', 'mpeg') THEN 'MEDIA' WHEN LOWER(B.FILE_EXTSN) IN ('jpg', 'jpeg', 'gif', 'png', 'bmp') THEN 'IMAGE' WHEN LOWER(B.FILE_EXTSN) IN ('mp3', 'wav', 'mid') THEN 'MUSIC' END AS mediaType, B.FILE_THUMNAIL AS fileThumnail, SUBSTRING(B.FILE_STRE_COURS FROM POSITION('/' IN B.FILE_STRE_COURS)) AS fileStreCours FROM TB_CONTENTFILEINFO A JOIN LETTNFILEDETAIL B ON A.ATCH_FILE_ID = B.ATCH_FILE_ID WHERE A.CON_SEQ = #{conSeq}::numeric AND A.DETAIL_SEQ = #{detailSeq}::numeric ORDER BY CAST(A.FILE_ORDER AS INTEGER) ASC
